Summary

The short version: strategy in the morning, storefront signage by afternoon.

Afsana is a marketing and branding professional with 11+ years of experience in brand strategy, digital marketing, and campaign execution — skilled at enhancing brand visibility, driving engagement, and managing multi-channel marketing initiatives end to end.

Her work spans both sides of the aisle: online (social strategy, PPC, content, web UX) and offline (TVCs, print, billboards, in-store branding, trade activation) — proficient in HubSpot CRM, Hootsuite, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and social media marketing at large.

Currently Brand Manager, Growth & Marketing at TallyKhata, following Three and Half years leading brand communication for Hikvision Bangladesh and eight years managing brand strategy at Global Brand Pvt. Ltd.

Experience

Three roles, one throughline: build the brand, then defend it everywhere it shows up.
May 2026 — Present
Brand Manager, Growth & Marketing
TallyKhata
  • Plan and execute marketing campaigns including OVC, TVC, static & print advertisements.
  • Strengthen brand positioning and visibility across online and offline channels.
  • Manage digital platforms including Facebook, YouTube, WhatsApp, LinkedIn & the company website.
  • Handle PR and media communications, including press releases and brand stories.
  • Manage procurement of marketing materials — leaflets, digital prints, promotional gifts.
  • Organize events, seminars, and promotional campaigns to increase brand awareness.
Oct 2022 — May 2026
Marketing Specialist, Brand Communication
Hangzhou Hikvision Digital Technologies Co. Ltd
  • Developed and implemented comprehensive marketing and communication strategies to drive product and brand growth.
  • Executed Above The Line (ATL) and Below The Line (BTL) initiatives, significantly enhancing brand visibility.
  • Planned and managed content across social platforms, achieving a 25% increase in audience engagement within six months.
  • Collaborated with agencies, service providers, and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) to optimize campaign performance.
  • Managed a marketing budget exceeding $500,000 annually, ensuring cost-effective resource allocation.
  • Coordinated the end-to-end interior build-out of Hikvision's Bangladesh regional office — see Special Project below.
2014 — 2022
Asst. Brand Manager, Brand Communication
Global Brand Pvt. Ltd
  • Led collaborative marketing campaigns with national distributors and second-tier dealer partners.
  • Designed and launched social media advertisements, driving 20% growth in online sales.
  • Implemented targeted trade marketing strategies, strengthening in-store visibility across high-potential regions.
  • Managed partner-house branding — in-store branding, signage, POSM, and display shelf setups.
  • Oversaw production for corporate gifts, brochures, and printed materials; worked with production houses on TVCs.
  • Designed and managed trade show booths and exhibition displays for major industry events.
  • Conducted market research and competitor analysis to inform brand positioning.
  • Managed budgets, vendor partnerships, and a cross-functional team of content creators and analysts.
